summary: The prepared main checkout already contains both the None-to-zero crash guard from upstream PR #27998 and the lazy speculative track-planning implementation from PR #30437. Added a focused GPU regression for the previously untested fresh-request and boundary cases; no runtime source change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The fetched pre-fix expression reproduced TypeError for mamba_next_track_idx=None; raw output is in raw/pre_fix_reproduction.log.

3 tests passed using an actual GPU-resident ping-pong mapping: fresh None defaults to slot 0 without request mutation, mixed slot values gather correctly, and a lazy-spec plan overrides request-local positions.
3 tests and 2 subtests passed for adjacent prepare-for-decode and post-verify mamba boundary lifecycle behavior.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests ran with ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 on AMD Instinct MI350X, capability (9, 5); rocminfo reports gfx950. See raw/pre_fix_reproduction.log, raw/pytest_mamba_track_indices.log, and raw/gpu_identity.log.

remaining_limitations: The Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 model weights were unavailable, so full-model semantic accuracy was not tested.
Only the assigned single gfx950 GPU was used; the reported two-NVIDIA-RTX-3090 serving workload and multi-GPU behavior were not reproduced.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is a different non-hybrid architecture and would not qualify this mamba-specific issue, so it was not used.
No native source changed; a native rebuild was not applicable.
